title: Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued May 4, 2022 Lock
主要内容: On May 4, 2022, the Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note detailing the execution of monetary policy decisions by the Federal Open Market Committee. The Board raised the interest rate on reserve balances to 0.9%, effective May 5, 2022. The Open Market Desk at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York was instructed to maintain the federal funds rate within a target range of 3/4 to 1 percent. Overnight repurchase agreements would be conducted with a minimum bid rate of 1.0% and an aggregate limit of $500 billion, while reverse repurchase agreements would be executed at 0.8% with a daily per-counterparty limit of $160 billion. The Fed also approved a 1/2 percentage point increase in the primary credit rate to 1%, effective May 5, 2022.
